title: Idempotency request hash omits principal, agent, and environment
evidence: audit_v2/phase2c/rerun_01/results/final_reaudit_checks.json: same_key_changed_principal_conflicts, same_key_changed_agent_conflicts, same_key_changed_environment_conflicts, and request_hash_material_dimensions failed. The second request replayed EXECUTED with the same hash instead of failing closed.
impact: A reused idempotency key can silently replay a prior success for a different principal, agent, or environment, misrepresenting an authorization context as successfully executed.
recommended_fix: Bind the canonical idempotency request hash to all material authorization and transaction dimensions: business, environment, principal, agent, provider, capability, resource, amount, currency, input payload, and any quote/confirmation identity when present.

title: Same-key confirmed retry is rejected before idempotency replay
evidence: audit_v2/phase2c/rerun_01/results/final_reaudit_checks.json: idempotency_confirmation_retry_replays_one_effect failed. First confirmed request EXECUTED; same key/same confirmation retry returned FAILED with CONFIRMATION_REPLAY.
impact: A legitimate transport retry of the same confirmed transaction can fail instead of replaying the completed idempotency result. This violates the final re-audit confirmation/idempotency invariant.
recommended_fix: Check idempotency for an existing same-hash success before consuming a confirmation replay token, while preserving confirmation binding/replay rejection for new keys or different request hashes.
